item.title: TT-104 Add TaskStore undo
item.brief:
Implement this ticket exactly as specified in BACKLOG.md in the registered repository `long-backlog`. Add focused standard-library unittest coverage for the behavior. Preserve existing tests and run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` before completing. Commit this ticket as its own separate commit; do not include other tickets. The repository ships locally, so do not push.

Ticket TT-104 acceptance criteria:
- Add TaskStore.undo() to revert most recent not-yet-undone add, complete, or delete; repeated calls walk backward across kinds.
- Undo add removes task; undo complete reopens it; undo delete restores exact task under same id.
- IDs are never reused, including after undo add.
- With no operation to undo raise NothingToUndo in tasktracker.store.
- Failed operations (such as completing unknown ID) are not recorded.

Implemented TaskStore undo for add, complete, and delete with LIFO history, preserved deleted task state and monotonic IDs, and added focused regression coverage including failed operations. The full unittest suite passes (7 tests); git diff --check is clean. Commits: 8004116 and 8ebec23. No open issues.

pr.body: Implemented an in-memory operation history in tasktracker/store.py. Undoing completion restores the previous status; undoing deletion restores the same Task object and fields; undoing addition removes the task without resetting ID allocation. Added standard-library unittest coverage for mixed operation ordering, exact deletion restoration, monotonically increasing IDs, empty history, and failed add/complete/delete calls. The required full suite passes (7 tests), and git diff --check passes. No persistence, concurrency, or migration behavior is involved.
pr.summary: Added LIFO undo for task additions, completion, and deletion. Before: store operations could not be reverted; now callers can undo each successful operation in reverse order while IDs remain unique.
pr.title: Add TaskStore undo support

risk.why: Contained in-memory behavior change in tasktracker/store.py with focused tests in tests/test_basic.py; no security, concurrency, persistence, or migration impact. The whole-change reviewer confirmed medium risk.

item.title: TT-103 Search query syntax

Implement this ticket exactly as specified in BACKLOG.md in the registered repository `long-backlog`. Add focused standard-library unittest coverage for the behavior. Ticket TT-103 acceptance criteria:
- Split query into terms on whitespace except inside double quotes; e.g. "fix login" is one phrase. All terms match (AND).
- Bare word or phrase matches title case-insensitively.
- tag:NAME matches an exact tag case-insensitively.
- status:open and status:done match status.
- Unknown field:value, unknown status, or unterminated quote raises QueryError in tasktracker.search.
- Empty/blank query matches every task; preserve input order.

item.title: TT-101 Reject impossible due dates
item.brief:
Implement this ticket exactly as specified in BACKLOG.md in the registered repository `long-backlog`. Add focused standard-library unittest coverage for the behavior. Preserve existing tests and run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` before completing. Commit this ticket as its own separate commit; do not include other tickets. The repository ships locally, so do not push.

Ticket TT-101 acceptance criteria:
- Impossible calendar dates (including 2026-02-30, 2025-02-29, 2026-04-31, 2026-13-01, 2026-00-10) raise InvalidDate, a ValueError subclass in tasktracker.dates, and its message contains original text.
- Unsupported forms raise InvalidDate, not bare ValueError.
- +Nd means N days after today and +0d means today; negative or unsigned offsets such as -3d and 3d raise InvalidDate.
- today and tomorrow continue to work; matching is case-insensitive and ignores surrounding whitespace.
